description: Get the train activity number for one US point: a number from 0 to 100 for the trains that pass within 1 mile, built from the train counts railroads report to the FRA. Give a latitude and longitude, or the point as at, like 41.587,-93.625. The point is rounded to 3 decimals. Returns the number, its band, the inputs behind it, the nearest crossing, the data date and a link to its page.

at.description: The point as latitude,longitude, like 41.587,-93.625. Use this or latitude and longitude, not both.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, like 41.587. Give it with longitude, or use at instead.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, like -93.625. Give it with latitude, or use at instead.

name: train_activity
